name: Legora
summary: Collaborative AI platform for lawyers covering review, research and drafting.
description: Legora is a collaborative AI platform for law firms. Lawyers use it to review documents, research and draft, and it presents an agentic operating system for legal work. The company announced a $550M Series E. Access is through a demo, and no public prices are listed. It is aimed at law firms and in-house legal teams. Security and customer pages are published on the site.

howToUse.title: Open Legora
howToUse.description: Open Legora and log in, or book a demo if a law firm or an in-house legal team is evaluating the collaborative platform.

howToUse.title: Review documents and research
howToUse.description: Use the workspace to review documents and do legal research, then draft from that material instead of starting from a blank page.

howToUse.title: Run work in the agentic system
howToUse.description: Hand a matter to the Agent inside the agentic operating system so it can plan and carry out the legal work, and keep the outputs in Lists tied to those documents.

features_fr: Plateforme d'IA collaborative pour les avocats couvrant la révision, la recherche et la rédaction.
Legora est une plateforme d'IA collaborative pour les cabinets d'avocats.
Les avocats l'utilisent pour réviser des documents, effectuer des recherches et rédiger des projets, et il présente un système d'exploitation agent pour le travail juridique.
La société a annoncé une série E de 550 millions de dollars.
